blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: complexity — Resource growth as input increases.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Specify output when inputs are empty, and preserve correctness on all-negative arrays.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Maintain invariant: best is the largest value among those inspected so far.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Compare against alternative sorting-based solution: an O(n) scan avoids O(n log n) sort when only the maximum is needed.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model response
blocks.text: The invariant tracks largest seen, not last examined.

blocks.title: Model response
blocks.text: Starting best at0 would be incorrect for all-negative arrays.
